# -------------------------------------------------------------------
# General Information
# -------------------------------------------------------------------
website:
  name: Jorgazo Rock
  url: https://jorgazorock.es
  current_edition: XI Edición (21 de noviembre de 2026)
  location: Paraje natural de Fuente Lunara, Cabeza la Vaca (Badajoz, Extremadura, España)
  entry: Gratuita
  description: >
    Jorgazo Rock is a non-profit, self-managed punk-rock festival held annually
    in the rural village of Cabeza la Vaca, Spain. It celebrates music,
    community, and rural life. Its XI edition takes place on November 21, 2026
    at Fuente Lunara with 8 alternative bands, doors opening at 13:00, popular-price
    food & drinks from 14:00, and a morning Orienteering Gymkana in Plaza Romero
    Castilla from 11:00 to 13:00.
  keywords:
    - Jorgazo Rock
    - Jorgazo Rock XI
    - punk rock festival
    - rural music festival
    - Cabeza la Vaca
    - Fuente Lunara
    - free festival
    - DIY culture
    - punk
    - rock
    - ska

# -------------------------------------------------------------------
# Organization
# -------------------------------------------------------------------
organization:
  name: Asociación Jorgazo Rock
  type: non-profit cultural association
  mission: >
    To promote cultural diversity and music in rural areas, based on principles
    of self-management, equality, and solidarity.
  contact:
    email: asociacionjorgazorock@gmail.com
